guard: the cotal_connect result carries the connection's orientation card and the shared briefing, because a conversation that joins through the gateway had no launch-time system prompt
why: A launched seat reads its briefing from its harness's system prompt. A conversation that joins
with cotal_connect (the Claude Code plugin in a session the person opened, Claude Desktop, a
hosted connector) has only the gateway's connect instructions, which say how to connect and
listen and nothing about how to work. The connect result is the one message every such
conversation reads, so the card and the briefing ride on it.
SPECIFIER BOUNDARY, checked rather than assumed. The suite imports the gateway by RELATIVE
SOURCE PATH (../src/gateway.js), so the bytes mutated are the bytes graded. It starts a real
broker, so the proof is live. No completionMarker: the suite is fail-fast and prints its
banner only on success, so there is no line common to both outcomes to declare.
